The structure of TlCdSe2 crystallizes in triclinic symmetry with space group P1, containing eight atoms per unit cell across eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd and Tl centers each coordinated by four Se neighbors, while Se centers display diverse coordination with varying Cd, Se, and Tl counts. A 3D geometric neighbor graph connects all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Cd- and Tl-centered 4-vertex coordination polyhedra, and between Cd- or Tl-centered polyhedra and 6-vertex Se-centered polyhedra.
